limitations: Whole unmodified human IPA vowel demonstrations, not sentence snippets, synthesized tones, or calibrated native-English targets.
Cardinal /i/ and /u/ recordings do not demonstrate English /iː/ and /uː/ duration. Long-symbol aliases provide vowel-quality examples only.
The open-mid back unrounded /ʌ/ demonstration is not universal English STRUT; realizations vary by accent.
Speakers, loudness, durations and recording quality differ; this is not a controlled English minimal-pair experiment.
